title: JavaScript ES6+ Applied Check
description: Test your ability to predict and apply modern JavaScript behavior with arrows, destructuring, spread, rest, Map, Set, and modern operators.
author: DailyCoder

questions.explanation: An arrow function with braces needs an explicit `return`. Without it, the function returns `undefined`.

questions.prompt: Which arrow function correctly returns an object literal?
questions.explanation: An implicitly returned object literal must be wrapped in parentheses.
`||` falls back for any falsy value, but `??` falls back only for `null` or `undefined`.
Optional chaining returns `undefined` instead of throwing, then `??` provides the fallback.
Object spread order matters. The later `...user` overwrites the earlier `role: "admin"`.
`Set` removes duplicate primitive values, and spread converts the Set back into an array.
Objects are unique by reference. `a` and `b` are different objects even though their contents match.
Computed property names evaluate the expression inside brackets, so `[key]` becomes `email`.
Array rest destructuring collects the remaining items into a new array.
Object rest collects the remaining properties after `password` is extracted.
`.set()` stores a key-value pair, and `.get()` retrieves the value for that key.
The optional chain starts too late. Since `user` is `null`, `user.profile` throws before `?.name` can help. Use `user?.profile?.name`.

questions.prompt: Which option best creates a new object with `active` changed to `false` without mutating `user`?
questions.explanation: Object spread creates a new top-level object and the later `active` property overrides the previous value.
Property shorthand uses the variable names as property names and their values as property values.

questions.prompt: Which statement about spread and rest is correct?

options.text: Spread collects values, rest expands values
Spread and rest use different symbols
Spread expands values, rest collects values
Rest can only be used with objects

questions.explanation: Both use `...`, but spread expands values while rest collects values.
